source: Nukta Habari - Ugonjwa wa kipindupindu, kuharisha ulivyowatesa Watanzania mwaka 2025 (4 February 2026)
processing_notes: Source states: 'Mbali na Kuharisha kipindupindu pia kiliwatesa Watanzania mwaka 2025, visa 3,433 na vifo 26' - interpreted as 3433 sCh cases, 26 deaths. Swahili-language Tanzanian data-journalism outlet reporting national Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR) figures from the Ministry of Health for calendar year 2025: 3433 cholera cases and 26 deaths. Translation: 'Besides diarrhoea, cholera also afflicted Tanzanians in 2025, 3,433 cases and 26 deaths'. CONFLICT DOCUMENTED, NOT RESOLVED: WHO Multi-Country Cholera Situation Report 32 gives 4101 cases and 55 deaths for Tanzania cumulative 1 January to 26 October 2025 (cholera_data_ai.csv Index 21), i.e. WHO's partial-year figure already exceeds this full-year MoH IDSR figure. Both numbers are recorded as published; they are not averaged. Likely causes: WHO's series counts suspected cholera plus acute watery diarrhoea, whereas the national IDSR line list applies the cholera case definition, and/or retrospective reclassification of suspected cases by the MoH. This row's unique contribution is that it is a FULL calendar-year 2025 national total from the national surveillance system, extending past the 26 October 2025 cut-off of the WHO rows. Confidence 0.6 reflects Level 3 access route (news outlet) despite Level 1 underlying data. Do not sum with Indices 19, 20 or 21.
retracted_reason: Mis-dated: 3433 cases/26 deaths is the Jan-Jun 2025 IDSR half-year total per the primary MoH Tanzania Public Health Bulletin Issue 15 (metadata 32), not calendar 2025. Calendar-2025 national total is 3987/47 per WHO Cholera Annual Report 2025 (WER 101(38), AI Index 168). The Jan-Jun value is preserved exactly by monthly Indices 53-58 (sum 3433/26). Flagged for withdrawal by prior Agent 1 (2026-09-21 batch 7); retracted by Agent 1 2026-09-30 on two Level-1 sources.
